name: Andersen Group Inc. Class A Common Stock
summary: Andersen is a prominent firm specializing in independent tax, valuation, and financial advisory services, primarily serving individuals, family offices, businesses, and alternative investment funds across the United States. The company distinguishes itself through a client-centric philosophy, deeply rooted in core values that champion stewardship, transparency, and the consistent provision of objective, high-quality service. Globally, Andersen's expansive footprint reaches over 180 countries through its vast network of member and collaborating firms. This international alliance delivers a comprehensive range of tax, legal, valuation, and consulting solutions from more than 1,000 locations, supported by a formidable team exceeding 3,000 partners and 50,000 professionals. Andersen Group Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Andersen Aggregator LLC.
